description: Explorer of the Seas, Feb 26 - Mar 5 2006 voyage (3,245 passengers + 1,183 crew = 4,428; CDC VSP investigation denominators). Royal Caribbean Voyager-class, maiden voyage 2000: ~311m LOA × 48m beam, 138,000 GT, 3,114 guests at double occupancy. Bins to mega_cruise_5000 under the passenger-complement rule (3,245 > 3,240.37 boundary). Staterooms on 7 decks (2-3 oceanview, 6-10 balcony / Promenade-view / inside); decks 4-5 are all-public, with the four-story Royal Promenade void through decks 5-8. Cabin-corridor resolution (38 pax + 6 crew corridors). Key venues: three-tier main dining room (Magellan / Da Gama / Columbus), Windjammer Café buffet, Royal Promenade, Palace Theatre, Studio B. Layout follows the Royal Caribbean deck plans (Feb 2006 configuration, valid 12-Feb-2006 to 22-Apr-2007: Portofino, Maharaja's Lounge, ShipShape spa; later refit venues and the deck-12 staterooms added in 2015 are not modeled) and cruisedeckplans.com deck plans for stateroom-bank geometry. Simplifications: corridor occupancy is the voyage complement spread evenly within each bank, not a per-stateroom count; each corridor carries one ventilation label (decks 6-8 midship atrium_view for the Promenade-view bank, other deck 6-10 corridors balcony_partial although they also serve inside staterooms); the Royal Promenade and each Centrum are single zones; venue volumes and capacities are plan-scaled estimates; crew decks, medical center, galley, laundry, stores and bridge are not on the published passenger plans and are placed as in the sibling recipes; no HVAC drawing is published, so air handlers are grouped by longitudinal position and function.
